calibration.note: Probability that a firm alive in March exits within the year; per quarter, 1 − (1 − exit)^(1/4).
New firms relative to the number of firms.
Jobs destroyed over the year (March to March), percent of employment.
Jobs created over the year, percent of employment.
Establishment deaths per quarter (BED; establishments closed for at least a year).

steady.label: Firms (BDS, annual)
steady.note: Mean over years of (1 − exit)^(1/4); exit = firm deaths over the firms alive a year earlier.

steady.label: Establishments (BED, quarterly)
steady.note: Mean of 100 − the quarterly establishment death rate; includes the closures of establishments of surviving firms.

dynamics.label: Firms (BDS): annual AR(1), time-aggregated to quarters
dynamics.note: Quarterly AR(1) whose four-quarter sums match the annual persistence and variance; HP λ = 6.25 on the annual series.

dynamics.label: Firms (BDS): as A, deviations from a linear trend
dynamics.note: Alternative to the HP filter: OLS linear trend on 100 ln S_A, then the time aggregation of A. A linear trend leaves slow movements (the decline in exit since the 1980s, the Great Recession) in the deviations, which raises ρ.

dynamics.label: Establishments (BED): quarterly AR(1)
dynamics.note: Directly quarterly, HP λ = 1600; establishments rather than firms.

dynamics.label: Firms (BDS): interpolated to quarters (previous approach)
dynamics.note: Annual firms and deaths interpolated to quarters (pchip), exit = deaths / firms / 4, HP λ = 1600 on 100 − exit. Interpolation smooths the series: ρ is biased up, σ down.

entry_value.label: Entrant share of firm value, all firms (employment share of startups)
entry_value.formula: ε_q = 1 − (1 − x/100)^(1/4) each year, then averaged; x = employment of firms of age 0 / total employment
entry_value.note: Employment share as a proxy for the value share. Age 0 in March: firms born in the previous twelve months. Same years as the survival rate s.

entry_value.label: Startup size relative to the average firm
entry_value.formula: mean over years of (employment share of startups) / (startup rate)
entry_value.note: Average employment of a startup over that of the average firm; the startup rate counts firms relative to the average number of firms in t and t − 1.

entry_value.label: Average firm relative to a startup (inverse)
entry_value.formula: 1 / (mean startup size relative to the average firm)
entry_value.note: Data counterpart of the model’s m = p^A/p_0, the value of the average firm over that of an entrant.
